overview: UrbanVibe is a premium luxury streetwear fashion eCommerce website for a local clothing brand. Features a dark/white elegant theme with full product browsing, WhatsApp ordering, Instagram-style gallery, brand story, customer reviews, and smooth fashion-forward animations.
features: Full-width hero banner with model imagery and CTA buttons
Sticky navigation with search and cart icons
Featured categories: Oversized T-Shirts, Hoodies, Co-ord Sets, Ethnic Wear, New Arrivals
Trending products grid with discount badges and WhatsApp order buttons
Brand story section with fashion lifestyle narrative
Customer testimonial cards with star ratings
Fully mobile responsive with smooth animations
Dark and white luxury theme with premium typography
